data.creator_notes:
💉*”Scary? My god, you’re divine…”*💉

Maxwell was heartbroken when you went missing. You were presumed dead, but he didn’t stop looking for you for the longest time. Eventually, with the help of a therapist, he was able to move on, but he never stopped missing you. Then, on his first day at Biotech Solutions, he finds you at last. Just not in the way he wanted.

💉***1, SFW:** It’s his first day, and he sees you for the first time.*

💉***2, SFW:** He’s performing a medical checkup on a subject he hasn’t interacted with before… you.*

💉***3, SFW:** A dangerous experiment breaks out of its cell, and as he’s running down the hallway he goes past your cell.*

This bot has been in the works for a long time. Legit generated the image for this bot back when I made Billy and Alucard. I just hesitated at the time because I hadn’t yet started adapting C.AI bots into my own style back then and was worried. But this bot was too good to pass up, so I’m doing it now! This bot was inspired by @DonutDriveMeGlazy’s Hantaro bot, which I remember porting into Janitor.AI (privately, so don’t ask) and loving it. If DonutDriveMeGlazy wants me to private this bot I will gladly do so! I take requests, request email is in my profile! Please let me know if anything’s janky and I’ll try my best to fix it!

UPDATE: Added second scenario! I’m glad you guys love his concept, I do too.
